idea-plugin.name: Kafka Topic Schema Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Validates a Kafka sample/message JSON file (named <topic>.sample.json or <topic>.message.json) against its sibling <topic>.schema.json JSON Schema file in the same directory -- inline, in the editor, no broker connection, no schema registry.

Flags real mismatches: wrong type, a missing required property, a value outside a declared enum -- each anchored at the exact spot in your sample file, not just a generic "invalid" banner.

100% static PSI analysis, never a real Kafka connection. Stated honestly: v0.1 covers the common JSON Schema subset (type, required, properties, items, enum) -- $ref, additionalProperties, pattern, numeric bounds, and oneOf/anyOf/allOf are not evaluated yet. Real, documented limitations, not silent gaps pretending to be complete coverage.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.

localInspection.displayName: Kafka sample message doesn't match its topic schema
